businessModel: Donation/user funded open-source project (same team as the cobalt media downloader)
updateCadence: Frequent 0.x releases (0.19.4 and 0.20.1 in October 2026), tracks Chromium within about a week
summary: A young, open-source desktop browser built on ungoogled-chromium that ships uBlock Origin and community filter lists enabled by default. Still beta, with no Widevine DRM and early sync work.
bestFor: Chromium users who want Google removed and blocking on by default
Open-source minded users on Windows, macOS or Linux
People coming from Arc-style layouts who want something simple
notFor: Users needing mobile versions or mature sync
Anyone who needs a stable, long-established project

pros.title: uBlock Origin built in
pros.detail: Ships uBO with community filter lists enabled out of the box.

pros.title: Ungoogled base
pros.detail: Removes Google services and tracking from Chromium.

pros.title: Open source
pros.detail: GPL-3.0 code; repository passed 20k GitHub stars in Sept 2026.

pros.title: Fast Chromium updates
pros.detail: Version 0.20.1 moved to Chromium 156.0.8078.47 within days.

cons.title: Beta quality
cons.detail: Version numbers are 0.x and many issues are open.

cons.title: No DRM
cons.detail: A September review reported no Widevine, so no Netflix-style streaming.

cons.title: Sync immature
cons.detail: Vault/private sync work only recently appeared in changelogs.

signatureFeatures: Zen mode and sidebar tab layouts

faq.q: Is Helium ready for daily use?
faq.a: It is still labelled beta (0.20.1) with many open issues, but is updated frequently.
A September 2026 review said it lacks Widevine, so DRM streaming was not supported.
imput (imputnet), the small team behind the cobalt media downloader.

timeline.event: 0.19.4 adds proxy flags and vault syncing; 0.20.1 updates to Chromium 156

switching.note: Imports from other Chromium browsers; password/sync support still limited.
